problem: Northstar Commerce needs consistent Azure project onboarding, isolated environments, private workloads and destination-owned data grants without managing Entra groups.
mvp: Azure-only declarative catalog/orders dev/prod; shared per-environment networks; RG-per-project; UAMI workloads; private storage and web apps; governance; local bootstrap then GitHub OIDC; authored manual checks. No execution beyond file/Git/registry work.

ownership.organization: logical requirements, naming, profiles, editable defaults
ownership.network: one state per environment owns VNet, subnets, NSGs, routing and Private DNS; project deletion retains shared resources
ownership.project: one resources state and separate access state per project/environment; project discovers shared names with ARM data sources
ownership.identity: external organization-identity owns teams; sensitive runtime map resolves logical teams
ownership.bootstrap: local retained state owns remote backend, deployment UAMI and GitHub federated credential; optional explicit migration to separate backend key

architecture.interfaces: Project discovery via projects/*/project.yaml; JSON subset of YAML for stdlib checking. Workload grants resolve named UAMI and ARM container ID without reading source state. Shared network platform allocates /26s by unique project network_slot. No dev/prod peering. App Service B1 private ingress and delegated egress; blob private endpoint; no storage keys. Public state endpoint is explicit GitHub-hosted-runner exception protected by Azure AD, no shared keys.
architecture.scope: No multi-cloud, portal, Kubernetes, AI, Databricks or third-party monitoring. Demonstration is private Python stdlib HTTP app with fixed Blob probes using its UAMI. Public GHCR image pushed manually later.
architecture.cost: Deploy dev only; B1 per demo app, LRS storage and private endpoints; no prod automatically; VPN/private operator host prerequisite for acceptance.
architecture.cleanup: Destroy grants, resources then network only when empty; keep shared network for scoped project removal. Bootstrap backend last after offline state backup.

validation.method: Source reading only during generation; all authored executable checks, tests, plans, builds, workflows, authentication and deployment PENDING manual execution. User prohibition overrides skill executable checks and registry validate command. Helper record metadata reconciliation is allowed.
acceptance: Onboarding, naming/tags, logical team and capability rejection, environment subnet boundaries and ownership
Policy rejects prohibited region/public storage; false-positive/bootstrap compatibility reviewed manually
Before separate grant apply catalog cannot read exports; after apply reads succeed, writes/restricted container fail
Private DNS and HTTPS private connectivity; RBAC bounded retries; test data created by explicit operator identity; cleanup documented

milestones.deliverable: Verified architecture and populated organization/project contracts, reusable template and historical ledger
milestones.acceptance: Read declarations and audit coverage; executable configuration checks remain pending.

milestones.acceptance: Read state ownership, security rules, bootstrap dependency and pinned schemas.

milestones.deliverable: Project resources, logical role resolution, explicit contracts and separate destination-owned grants; minimal private demo
milestones.acceptance: Read network/RBAC split and dependency graph; manual denied-before/after sequence authored.

milestones.deliverable: Dispatch-only workflows, input checks, full manual startup, test scripts and cleanup runbooks
milestones.acceptance: Read secret wiring/log suppression and consistency of commands; all executable verification pending.

improvements.baseline: Reusable template and manual folder creation
improvements.change: Add local onboarding generator that allocates a free slot and writes project/environment configurations without shared edits.
improvements.acceptance: Authored fixtures prove no central list edit, collision rejection and grant review; tests pending.

improvements.baseline: Manual checks and unit plan/apply workflows
improvements.change: Add dispatch-only drift/governance/access review orchestration with bounded role checks, safe output, no automatic remediation.
improvements.acceptance: Authored drift exit-code and role review procedures; all checks pending.
